We need to count carbonyl groups in the molecule. But we have no SMILES given. Possibly the sample is implicit? The system likely has a "sample at hand" which is the molecule under investigation. We need to determine number of carbonyl groups. We can use IR spectra to detect C=O stretch, or carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~190-210 ppm). But easiest: use IR spectra tool to get IR, then count C=O peaks. Or carbon NMR to see carbonyl signals. Since we just need count, maybe IR is enough.

We should call ir_spectra tool.
